description: BeschleunigerBallett's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ContainerHub's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in OmniAccelerANT and jotrockenmitlocken.

The part this repo cannot get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default. This repo carries fifteen gitlinks - two owned (third_party/ContainerHub at `main`, third_party/OxidANT at `develop`) and thirteen vendored - and not one of them has ever had a bump proposed by anything. The hub gitlink is the expensive one: the Linux and Windows lanes run the gates that live behind that pin, so a stale gitlink means CI grades this tree with whatever the hub looked like the last time someone moved it by hand.

The manager bumps a gitlink to the tip of the branch named in .gitmodules, falling back to the remote's DEFAULT branch when none is named. Every submodule here now names its branch explicitly except third_party/FUZZTEST, which is the one case where no value is correct - see the comment above that section in .gitmodules, and the packageRule below that stops the fallback from acting on it unattended.

Actions: the preset's helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests will propose digest pins for the third-party actions this repo references by tag (actions/checkout@v7.0.1, actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.1, codecov/codecov-action@v7.0.0, SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action@v4.4.0), while a preset rule explicitly leaves the five Kataglyphis/ContainerHub composite actions at @main for the upstream-first change flow.

Unlike the three sibling consumers, this repo has never carried a .github/dependabot.yml, so adopting the preset is a pure addition here - there is no hand-over to sequence and nothing to delete afterwards.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from ContainerHub's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ContainerHub, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And the Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09), so no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: ContainerHub's linux/scripts/renovate-local.sh reads exactly it.

third_party/FUZZTEST now NAMES its branch (release_2026-06-29 in .gitmodules), so the git-submodules manager tracks that line and the old fallback onto main cannot happen. Measured 2026-09-10: the pin 704efb34 is byte-identical to both refs/tags/2026-06-29 and refs/heads/release_2026-06-29, so this submodule is UP TO DATE on its line; main sits at d1dc1347, 81 commits away on a line this pin was never taken from.
Approval is kept for the LINE CHANGE itself. Moving from one dated release to the next is a deliberate act -- the customManager above surfaces the new date, and a human decides when to take it.
The depName for the git-submodules manager is the submodule PATH, which is why the match is on `third_party/FUZZTEST`.

third_party/CMakeLists.txt pulls four dependencies with FetchContent, and Renovate has NO manager that reads CMake -- abseil-cpp, googletest, microsoft/GSL and Corrosion have never had an update proposed by anything, by the App or by renovate-local.sh.

Two of them carry a real version and are annotated directly above their pin. ABSL_TAG uses abseil's LTS format (20260526.0), which is not semver -- the default parser cannot order it, hence versioning=loose in the annotation. GSL is plain semver and needs no override, which is why the versioning group is optional and one manager serves both shapes.

The other two are deliberately NOT annotated, and that is the finding rather than an omission. googletest is pinned to an archive of commit 56efe398, a digest and not a version. Corrosion is pinned to `master`: that is not a version at all, so this build is not reproducible from its sources, and pinning it is an owner decision this manager must not paper over.

Keep the ABSL_TAG comment above the pin in mind when taking a bump: the tag must stay >= the one FUZZTEST pins in third_party/FUZZTEST/cmake/BuildDependencies.cmake. Moving abseil UP is always safe for that constraint; moving it down is not.
The file pattern uses character classes rather than escapes, because the delimiters of a Renovate regex string are slashes and an inner one would end it early.

third_party/FUZZTEST follows google/fuzztest's DATED RELEASE LINE, not its default branch. The line is named in .gitmodules as `branch = release_<date>`, and this manager is what keeps that name current: it reads the date out of the branch name and compares it against the repo's tags, which upstream publishes as bare dates (2024-10-25 ... 2026-06-29, eight of them so far) alongside identically named release_<date> branches.
The regex versioning maps a date onto major.minor.patch so the ordering is the calendar's. Without it a bare `2026-06-29` is unparseable and every tag would look equally new.
Why this and not a bare `branch =`: pinning the line stops the walk onto main, but nothing would then tell you a NEWER line exists. This does.
